title: amount_usd is the value of THIS action -- not the cumulative, the maximum, or the obligation
why: Most paragraphs in this corpus carry two to four dollar figures. Exactly one is the value of the action being announced. Every other figure -- cumulative face value, maximum with options, funds obligated at time of award -- has its own meaning, and picking the wrong one is a silent multi-hundred-million-dollar error that no schema validation will catch.
verified_against: the announcement prose, by hand. Not verified against any model output -- cache/llm/ is empty.

checks.quote: Rockwell Collins Inc., Cedar Rapids, Iowa, was awarded a cost-plus-fixed-fee, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for command, control and communications integration ... The amount of this action is $38,916,896 with a total cumulative face value of $55,146,864. One bid was solicited with one received. ... Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity (W58RGZ-26-F-A009).
checks.reason: The award sentence names no figure at all; the amount appears only in 'The amount of this action is $38,916,896'. $55,146,864 is the cumulative.

checks.quote: Environmental Chemical Corp., Burlingame, California, is awarded a $128,363,354 firm-fixed-price contract for construction services ... The maximum dollar value, including the base price and 13 options, is $174,443,268.
checks.reason: $174,443,268 is an option-inclusive maximum, not a cumulative face value and not this action's value. The text states no cumulative face value, so that field is null.

checks.quote: The maximum dollar value, including the base price and 13 options, is $174,443,268.
checks.reason: Recording the option-inclusive maximum as the award value overstates it by $46M.

checks.quote: Paligen Aerospace & Defense LLC,* Tampa, Florida, was awarded a $30,840,628 modification (P00005) to undefinitized contract action W519TC-25-F-0015 for design, construction and commissioning of a trinitrotoluene production facility. The total cumulative face value is $435,000,000.
checks.reason: A $30.8M action against a $435M cumulative -- a 14x error if the two are swapped.

checks.quote: KBR Services LLC, Houston, Texas, was awarded a $17,000,000 modification (001 CB) to contract W52P1J-12-G-0061 to complete care of supplies in storage and other maintenance of government equipment. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $165,655,369.
checks.reason: A modification number is not always a P-number. '001 CB' is the token in parentheses after the word 'modification'.

checks.quote: Northrop Grumman Systems Corp., Riverdale, Utah, has been awarded an $86,069,000 task order (FA8214-26-F-B017) under previously awarded ground subsystem support contract 2.0 FA8214-21-D-0002 ... Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $15,240,085 are being obligated at the time of award.
checks.reason: $15,240,085 is what was obligated on day one, not the value of the action. Obligation figures are never amount_usd.

checks.quote: Fiscal 2026 procurement funds in the amount of $15,240,085 are being obligated at the time of award.
checks.reason: The phrase 'in the amount of' attaches to the obligation, and is the likeliest thing to be mistaken for 'the amount of this action'.

checks.quote: Aleut Construction LLC,* Reston, Virginia, has been awarded a $52,525,333 modification (P00001) to previously awarded contract FA8501-25-C-0005 for a narrow body paint booth. This modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $56,116,956 from $3,591,623.
checks.reason: The sentence gives the cumulative both AFTER ($56,116,956) and BEFORE ($3,591,623). cumulative_face_value_usd is the total after this action.

checks.quote: brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $56,116,956 from $3,591,623
checks.reason: $3,591,623 is the value before the modification.
